name: S3 concurrent upload must preserve root upload error identity

payload.p_check: WriterOption.Concurrency > 1 routes S3 Create through s3manager.Uploader with an io.Pipe; the background goroutine receives an upload error while the foreground writer/closer observes pipe state.
payload.q_claim: the final user-visible Write/Close error must preserve the root upload failure identity and context, not replace it with a secondary pipe close/read/write error

boundary.before: UploadWithContext/Upload returns a chosen root error in the background goroutine
boundary.after: ExternalFileWriter.Write or Close returns to the caller

name: Concurrent pipe upload preserves injected root error

payload.contract: When a background uploader fails with a chosen root error while the foreground side uses an io.Pipe, the final Write/Close result must preserve the root error instead of a secondary pipe close/read/write error.
minimal_observation: force the background upload path to return mock error
write more than one multipart chunk so the concurrent path is exercised
call Close and inspect the returned error
RED if final error is io: read/write on closed pipe or does not contain the injected root
GREEN if final error contains the injected root error

lessons.fix_shape: Use CloseWithError(err) on the pipe reader when the background uploader fails, so the foreground pipe writer sees the root error instead of a generic closed-pipe error.
lessons.method_note: The fix location is the ownership transition between background root error and foreground pipe state, not the caller's final error formatting.
